name: Daily Taiwan Eligible Async Remote Job Hunter

parameters.content:
## Setup checklist
1. Open **Config** and replace the placeholder Google Sheet ID and Telegram chat ID.
2. Create a Google Sheet named **Taiwan Eligible Async Remote Jobs** with tabs: `Raw Jobs`, `Filtered Jobs`, `Applied`, `Rejected` (see README for columns).
3. Attach credentials on: all **Google Sheets** nodes, the **Telegram** nodes (or swap in the disabled **Gmail** nodes), and both **Anthropic (Claude)** HTTP Request nodes (HTTP Header Auth, header name `x-api-key`, value = your Anthropic API key). Also add header `anthropic-version: 2023-06-01` (already set on the node).
4. Re-select the sheet/tab in each Google Sheets node dropdown after import (n8n requires this once per new sheet).
5. The 5 "best-effort" source nodes (Wellfound, Himalayas, Dynamite Jobs, Y Combinator Work at a Startup, Otta) are disabled — none of these expose a stable public API/RSS feed. Wire in a real scraper (e.g. an Apify actor, ScrapingBee, or Browserless) and enable them, or leave disabled and rely on RemoteOK + Remotive + We Work Remotely.

## Filtering pipeline (left to right)
Keyword relevance -> dedupe vs sheet -> hard keyword filter -> AI Taiwan-eligibility check (Claude) -> async/timezone keyword filter -> role-fit scoring -> weighted score -> final decision (apply now / manual check / reject) -> one-sentence rule safety net.

Every rejection branch tags `rejection_category` + `rejection_reason` and flows into the shared **Format Rejected Row** node so the Rejected sheet and the daily digest counts stay in sync.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ (() => {
  const promptHeader = 'You are filtering remote jobs for Jerry, who lives in Taiwan.

' +
    'The most important rule:

' +
    'Jerry must be able to work this job while physically based in Taiwan.

' +
    'Do not pass the job only because it says "remote."

' +
    'Reject the job if it requires the worker to live in the US, Canada, UK, EU, Europe, Australia, or any specific country outside Taiwan.

' +
    'Reject the job if it requires local work authorization outside Taiwan.

' +
    'Reject the job if it is hybrid, onsite, or remote within one country only.

' +
    'Reject the job if it requires fixed working hours that would force Jerry to work through the night in Taiwan.

' +
    'Keep the job only if one of these is true:

' +
    'The job says worldwide remote.

' +
    'The job says work from anywhere.

' +
    'The job says global remote.

' +
    'The job says APAC remote.

' +
    'The job allows international contractors.

' +
    'The job accepts people based anywhere.

' +
    'The company hires through EOR, Deel, Remote.com, Oyster, or contractor agreement.

' +
    'Return JSON only:

' +
    '{
"taiwan_eligible": "yes/no/unclear",
"reason": "short reason",
"location_risk": "low/medium/high",
"timezone_risk": "low/medium/high",
"contractor_possible": "yes/no/unclear",
"decision": "keep/reject/manual_check"
}

' +
    'Job post:

';
  return {
    model: $('Config').item.json.anthropic_model,
    max_tokens: 300,
    messages: [ { role: 'user', content: promptHeader + String($json.description || '').slice(0, 6000) } ]
  };
})() }}

={{ (() => {
  const bg = 'Bilingual English and Mandarin. Grew up in California and Taiwan. Digital marketing background. Data science bootcamp experience. Python, SQL, Tableau, Power BI. Performance marketing, SEO, PPC, GA4, Meta Ads, Google Ads. AI tools: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor. Experience with dashboards, EDA, machine learning projects, customer segmentation, fraud detection, and marketing analytics.';
  const prompt = 'Write a short cover letter for Jerry.

' +
    'Jerry is based in Taiwan and wants async global remote work.

' +
    'Use this background:

' + bg + '

' +
    'Make the letter specific to this job.

' +
    'Job title: ' + $json.job_title + '
' +
    'Company: ' + $json.company + '
' +
    'Job description: ' + String($json.description || '').slice(0, 3000) + '

' +
    'Mention how Jerry can help the company:

' +
    'reduce manual analysis time
' +
    'improve reporting speed
' +
    'connect marketing and data
' +
    'build AI-assisted workflows
' +
    'turn messy data into business action

' +
    'Keep it under 220 words.

' +
    'Tone:

' +
    'confident
' +
    'direct
' +
    'human
' +
    'not desperate';
  return {
    model: $('Config').item.json.anthropic_model,
    max_tokens: 500,
    messages: [ { role: 'user', content: prompt } ]
  };
})() }}
